### Continental final awaits shootout winners [...] Although the Argentine club registered him domestically on October 9 outside the standard transfer window via an exception, CONMEBOL barred him from the first leg. After CAS intervened, head coach Cacique Medina started him in a back three on Thursday before Palacios replaced him in the 77th minute, while the visitors overcame Baltasar Rodriguez's 50th-minute red card alongside five-time World Cup veteran Muslera's heroics.

Advertisement

Advertisement [...] Estudiantes originally brought the La Plata academy graduate back as an emergency signing because centre-backs Gonzalez Pirez and Tomas Palacios were suspended for the opening leg. Contracted to Racing until December, Rojo left Diego Milito's club acrimoniously after Estudiantes agreed a $500,000 release fee plus a $250,000 bonus for reaching the final and $450,000 for lifting the trophy.
